card.name: Space or point before oncology dose numbers
card.fires_on: The space, decimal point or opening parenthesis just before a dose number in cancer-drug dosing text, such as 'every <<>>3 weeks' or '1<<.>>8 mg/kg'. It is seen with brand-name oncology drugs like YONDELIS, ADCETRIS, POLIVY and XPOVIO.

modes.label: Space before number
modes.description: The blank just before a dose amount or interval number after 'dose is', 'every' or 'at'.
modes.example: Recommended dosage of XPOVIO is<< >>100 mg taken orally once weekly

modes.label: Decimal point in dose
modes.description: The decimal point inside a mg/kg dose or a section reference number.
modes.example: The recommended dose of POLIVY is 1<<.>>8 mg/kg as an intravenous infusion

card.plain: It fires at the spot right before the number in a cancer-drug dose, such as the space or decimal point.
